role_evidence.quote: Participants experiencing their first recurrence glioblastoma multiforme (GBM) will be dosed the maximal tolerated dose of GLR2007 as determined in Part 1 until lack of tolerance or disease progression.

coder_notes: Basket: NSCLC, brain metastases and recurrent GBM cohorts; GBM named in conditions, arm label and inclusion. cns5 'historical' from 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' and 'WHO Grade IV' with no IDH requirement.
